svg.title: What happens to the copy of a document
svg.desc: An exported document is in the archive. Moved to the trash in Paperless, or gone from Paperless without the trash for N complete scans, its copy moves to _Gelöscht; restored in Paperless, it moves back to the archive. Deleted for good in Paperless, the copy in _Gelöscht is deleted in Nextcloud after N complete scans, when permanent deletion is on. A copy in the archive whose document is gone from Paperless without the trash for N complete scans is deleted directly when permanent and direct deletion are on.
